intro: QSNCC is Bangkok's largest convention and exhibition center, hosting trade fairs, concerts and big events year-round. It sits on Ratchadaphisek Road on the Khlong Toei side, directly above Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre MRT station. People attending usually ask one thing: where do you stay so you can walk to the hall without fighting traffic? We've kept this list to hotels you can genuinely walk to, plus a few that are one MRT stop away, with the real distance spelled out for each.

blocks.html: Short answer: If you're attending a QSNCC event and want to genuinely walk to the hall, only a handful of hotels work — Modena by Fraser (5-min walk, inside the FYI tower by the MRT), Wyndham Queen Convention Centre (6-min walk) and Spark Hotel (8-min walk, budget). From any of these you can step out and walk straight to the venue. For a five-star room or the shopping side at Asok–Phrom Phong, it's one MRT stop or a 7–10 minute drive.

blocks.text: Hotels near QSNCC, by distance & budget

items.name: Spark Hotel - MRT Queen Sirikit
items.meta: 📍 8-min walk (600 m) to QSNCC · ★ 3-star · Best for: Budget · walk to the venue · by the MRT · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The lightest-priced pick that still genuinely walks to the venue. It's about 250 m from Queen Sirikit MRT and roughly an 8-minute walk to the hall. Rooms are compact but clean, with a work desk, mini-bar and an on-site bar. A good fit for anyone manning a booth or doing the expo circuit who'd rather save on the room and spend at the show. Reviews praise the location and how quiet the rooms are.

items.name: Gardina Asoke Hotel & Residence
items.meta: 📍 10-min walk (750 m) to MRT · free tuk-tuk shuttle to QSNCC · ★ 4-star · Best for: Families · pool & garden · between Asok and QSNCC · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: On a quiet lane between Asok BTS and Queen Sirikit MRT, about 750 m (a 10-minute walk) from the MRT, or you can take the hotel's free tuk-tuk shuttle to Asok. It has family rooms and serviced-residence units plus a pool, gym, sauna and a leafy garden. Good for a multi-day event when you want more space and full facilities without a steep rate.

items.name: Wyndham Bangkok Queen Convention Centre
items.meta: 📍 6-min walk (450 m) · 250 m from MRT to QSNCC · ★ 4-star · Best for: Kitchenette rooms · free parking · walk to venue · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: One of the closest to the venue — about a 6-minute walk to QSNCC and only ~250 m from the MRT. Rooms are fairly spacious with a kitchenette, a work desk and a sitting area, which suits multi-day exhibitors or longer stays. There's a rooftop pool and, unusually for this area, free parking — handy if you're driving in.

items.name: Citadines Sukhumvit 16 Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 6-min walk (500 m) or one MRT stop to QSNCC · ★ 4-star · Best for: Longer stays · in-room kitchen · near Sukhumvit · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A serviced apartment on Sukhumvit Soi 16, about a 6-minute walk to Queen Sirikit/Sukhumvit MRT, or one MRT stop. Units are studios and one-bedrooms with a fully equipped kitchen, fridge and, in some, a washer — handy for a week-long event stint when you want to cook now and then. It sits close to both Sukhumvit and Ratchadaphisek, so getting around is easy.

items.name: Modena by Fraser Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 5-min walk (450 m) · in the FYI tower by the MRT to QSNCC · ★ 4-star · Best for: Shortest walk to venue · longer stays · kitchenette · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The strongest pick if you want the shortest daily walk to and from the venue. It's inside the FYI Center tower right by Queen Sirikit MRT, roughly a 5-minute walk to the convention center. As a serviced apartment, rooms have a kitchenette, fridge and a proper work desk — ideal for multi-day exhibitors or crews who are in and out of the hall constantly. There's a pool, gym and restaurants in the building.

items.name: Carlton Hotel Bangkok Sukhumvit
items.meta: 📍 8-min drive (2.6 km) or one MRT stop to QSNCC · ★ 5-star · Best for: Five-star · high-floor views · by Sukhumvit MRT/Asok BTS · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A five-star high-rise on Sukhumvit by Sukhumvit MRT and Asok BTS. From Sukhumvit MRT it's just one stop to QSNCC, or about an 8-minute drive (2.6 km). Upper-floor rooms pull in city views, and there's a sky pool, spa, the Cantonese restaurant Wah Lok and a rooftop bar. A fit for anyone who wants full five-star comfort with the Asok shopping-and-dining scene, then rides the MRT to the event.

items.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Sukhumvit Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 9-min drive (2.8 km) or MRT from Phrom Phong to QSNCC · ★ 5-star · Best for: Near Phrom Phong/Emporium · shopping · Hilton service · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: On Sukhumvit Soi 26 near the Emporium mall and Phrom Phong BTS, about 2.8 km from QSNCC — roughly a 9-minute drive, or walk to Phrom Phong BTS and change to the MRT at Sukhumvit. Rooms are spacious, with a pool, a poolside bar and dependable Hilton service. Good for anyone who wants the Phrom Phong shopping-and-dining scene after hours and only needs to be at the venue some days.

faq.q: Which hotel is the closest walk to QSNCC?
faq.a: Modena by Fraser Bangkok is the shortest walk — it's inside the FYI Center tower next to Queen Sirikit MRT, about a 5-minute walk (450 m) to the hall. Next closest are Wyndham Queen Convention Centre (6-min walk) and Spark Hotel (8-min walk, budget). From all three you can step out and walk to the event without a taxi.

faq.q: If I stay around Asok–Sukhumvit, how do I get to QSNCC?
faq.a: Easiest is the MRT — Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre station sits directly under the building. From Asok–Sukhumvit, walk to Sukhumvit MRT (linked to Asok BTS) and take the MRT toward Hua Lamphong; QSNCC is the very next stop. It's just a few minutes and skips the road traffic.

faq.q: How do I get from Suvarnabhumi Airport to QSNCC?
faq.a: Take the Airport Rail Link from Suvarnabhumi to Makkasan, walk across to Phetchaburi MRT, then ride the MRT toward Hua Lamphong two stops to QSNCC — about 40–50 minutes total with no traffic. With lots of luggage or a group, a metered taxi straight to your hotel works too, roughly 45–60 minutes depending on traffic.
